  Implementation of the counting sort algorithm.

  Args:
    arr: An array of numbers to be sorted.

  Returns:
    A new array with the same elements as arr sorted in ascending order.

  min_element = min(arr)

  # Create an array to store the counts

  # Count the occurrence of each element

  # Calculate the cumulative sum of counts

  # Create a new array to store sorted elements

  # Insert the elements back into sorted array based on their counts

    sorted_arr[count[i - min_element] - 1] = i

  n = len(list_)
  for i in range(n):
    # Last i elements are already in place

        # Swap elements
        list_[j], list_[j+1] = list_[j+1], list_[j]
